description:
Cast Turtle Blimp by paying {5}.
When Turtle Blimp enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Mutant creature token.
Activate Turtle Blimp's crew ability by tapping the Mutant, causing Turtle Blimp to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Mutant and Turtle Blimp, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Turtle Blimp dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Turtle Blimp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
